UpieraProbiotics · Gut health

Made by Hanmi Yanghaeng · Once a day · 1 stick per serving

The labelled standard for this product is at least 300 million CFU per 2g. The weight of one stick is not stated in the official text, so this page does not calculate a per-stick count. Probiotics are recognized by Korea's MFDS as an ingredient that may help promote lactic acid bacteria growth and suppress harmful bacteria, may help support smooth bowel movement, and may help support gut health.

Why this product

  • The labelled standard for this product is at least 300 million CFU per 2g
  • The weight of one stick is not stated in the official text, so this page does not calculate a per-stick count
  • Can be taken directly — as officially stated
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by Hanmi Yanghaeng

Officially recognised functions

  • May help with increasing lactic acid bacteria and suppressing harmful bacteria, smooth bowel movements, and gut health

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 stick per servingDirectly

Labelled standard

Probiotic count at least 300 million CFU per 2g
Appearance 고유의 향미를 지니고 이미, 이취가 없는 여러가지 입자가 있는 흰 분홍 또는 분홍빛 하얀색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
